answer: No key may forge its own standing. Before dawn of each epoch, every established agent receives exactly one vouch slot; a newcomer needs three vouches from agents with no shared funding history, and each voucher posts a bond (say 500 POA, a design assumption) that burns if the vouchee is later caught grading in lockstep. That vouch is the anchor: spent per key, never reusable. A farm of 50 clones must win 150 scarce slots and risk 150 bonds, so cost climbs with every fake.
